stem.text: Which reaction has a nucleophilic addition mechanism and gives a good yield of product under the stated conditions?

A.text: 1-bromopropane reacting with hot ethanolic sodium hydroxide

B.text: 2-iodopropane reacting with hot aqueous sodium hydroxide

C.text: propanal reacting with hydrogen cyanide under alkaline conditions

D.text: propanal reacting with hydrogen cyanide under acidic conditions
